what: CareTrust REIT owns skilled nursing facilities and senior housing and leases them to operators. It owns the buildings and increasingly lends to operators as well.
customers: Nursing home and senior housing operators across the United States and, since 2025, Britain.
money: mortgage and mezzanine loans to operators
moat: Relationships with regional nursing operators and a balance sheet with almost no leverage, which lets it buy facilities when stressed sellers need to move quickly.
risks: If an operator stops paying, the REIT must find a replacement and that takes time
Nursing home revenue depends on Medicaid and Medicare rates set by governments
23 times earnings after a period of rapid acquisition, which has to be digested
opportunities: A 67.3% net margin and $485M of free cash flow on $615M of revenue
Revenue grew from $192M to $476M in four years, among the fastest growth in healthcare property
Only $894M of debt against $198M of cash, which leaves room to keep buying
watch: Rent coverage at its operators and the pace of new acquisitions.
